node.title: Cyclic quotient rotation closes the rate-half list-unsafe band
node.statement: For C=RS[F,D,n/2], c|n/2, N=n/c, 0<s<c, 1<=d<=N/2-1, and m=N/2+d, cyclic rotation modulo Y^N-delta plus a fixed s-point tail gives at least ceil(C(N-1,m)/(N*q^(d-1))) distinct codewords at agreement n/2+dc+s. At the official cap row, N*q^d < 2^128*C(N-1,m) even at q=2^256, with 75.0796 bits of margin; hence the whole residual band is list-unsafe for ordinary and every constant common-support interleaving arity. || MAXIMAL-PREFIX INSTANTIATION (wave-9, 2026-07-17): the count is s-INDEPENDENT (s = c-1 lemma), so the proved unsafe band extends to 1 <= sigma <= sigma_max = 8,594,128,895 — past the former sigma* reach (history preserved in statement.md).
